incidents.name: GPT fee-mechanism exploitation
incidents.notes: GPT's transfer fee is taken from the liquidity pair's own balance and routed back into the token without a sync(), so repeated flash-loaned transfers shifted the reserve and let the attacker extract the pair's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: GPT 0xa1679abEF5Cd376cC9A1C4c2868Acf52e08ec1B3 created 2023-05-24T13:23:49Z by 0xc1727c083ea796addefcf594ce9114160a49f3aa, unrelated to attack sender 0x054a3574d8082112575843dd944ff42c58dda38d; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment (the token was under three hours old). Loss verified onchain: 58,520.32 USDT left the GPT pair 0x77a684943aA033e2E9330f12D4a1334986bCa3ef and 42,973.44 USDT reached the attack contract.
